text:
Priya Nair: Heads-up team  we got the intake from AWS Marketplace PM. They want a single deliverable bundle with SKU map, AMIs, pricing matrix, and legal attachments by next Tue. Can we confirm owners?
Ben Ortiz: I'll take SKU map + pricing matrix. Proposal: list hourly + monthly for Standard, monthly+commit for Dedicated. Put hourly under "preview" on listings.
Sarah Li: Legal here  need the EULA PDF per region and a short export-control declaration. Also flag any features that persist customer data in marketplace docs.
Olivia Ramos: I'll own the SOC/export docs and provide contact for compliance. Also I'll gather AMI IDs and GCP image URIs.
Priya Nair: Great. Ben can you paste a sample SKU CSV format so Marketplace PM can ingest?
Ben Ortiz: Sure, sample: 
```
sku_id,display_name,plan_type,pricing_unit,regions,notes
RDW-STD,Redwood Standard,hourly+monthly,per-vCPU,global,preview: hourly
RDW-DED,Redwood Dedicated,monthly+commit,per-gpu,us-east-1;eu-west-1,requires-sales-engage
RDW-SUP,Redwood Premium Support,addon,monthly,global,
```
Ben Ortiz: I'll push the full sheet to the partnership drive and tag the PM.
Sarah Li: Also include localized consumer terms (EN/FR/DE/ES). Marketplace requires translated short descriptions for EU/UK. Priya, do we have translation budget?
Priya Nair: Yes, translations approved for core assets. @Olivia make sure the copy is final before you send to localization.
Olivia Ramos: Copy update: short description for Standard: "Low-latency hosted LLM inference with usage-based pricing." For Dedicated: "Dedicated GPU pools with SLA-backed throughput and isolation." I'll drop these into the assets bundle.
marketplace-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-mkt/listings/v3/listing_bundle_202405.tar.gz (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e)
Priya Nair: Ops question  do AMIs need public snapshot IDs or account-locked images for BYOL customers? AWS PM prefers public AMIs for quick onboarding.
Olivia Ramos: We need account-locked images for Dedicated customers (security) but can provide public AMIs for Standard. I'll coordinate with infra to produce both.
Ben Ortiz: On pricing matrix, include estimated monthly cost-per-1M tokens and per-hour GPU rate. Also add a note about discounts for committed usage.
Sarah Li: Will prepare a one-page legal cover letter summarizing differences between cloud offers, and call out data residency commitments.
Priya Nair: Nice. Last item: marketplace listing contact and escalation. Let's add a single email alias for PM and a backup.
Olivia Ramos: Using marketplace@redwood.ai and marketplace-biz@redwood.ai as backup.
Ben Ortiz: I'll schedule a walkthrough with AWS PM once bundle is ready. Suggest Friday 10am PT.
marketplace-bot: reminder set: marketplace-bundle-due in 72h
Priya Nair: Thanks team. Action items recap in doc: Ben (SKU/pricing), Olivia (images + localization handoff), Sarah (EULA + cover letter), Priya (submit bundle + AWS sync). Meeting Friday if bundle ready. :)
